title: Operations management, with practical AI.

mgs.title: Keeping recurring production moving across a remote studio
mgs.summary: Four years coordinating recurring review and publishing for an international studio releasing three times a week, plus Patreon.
mgs.context: Michael Ghelfi Studios produces tabletop audio with an international remote team. As Studio Manager, I ran daily operations across editorial review, video production, publishing schedules, and website maintenance for three weekly releases and Patreon.
items: Reviewed writer submissions, gave editorial feedback, and kept scripts consistent across releases.
Edited and published the studio's YouTube releases and Patreon packages.
Administered the WordPress site, managed plugins, and maintained custom mu-plugins.
Handled publishing automations, scheduling pipelines, and studio social announcements.
mgs.decisions: Decided editorial themes, release schedules, thumbnail A/B tests, audio playlists, and generative image concepts.
steps: Generated the artwork using AI tools
Assembled the full album video from the composer's audio tracks
Scheduled and published the final release
mgs.reach: The release reached 936,714 views on YouTube (verified September 2026), reflecting the combined impact of the music, visual packaging, and studio distribution.
mgs.also: I adapted the studio's commissioned black-and-white mark with a metallic-gold treatment for featured releases. The original mark was designed by another creator.

mapa.title: Turning client-facing spreadsheets into an interactive explanation
mapa.summary: Mapa da Bella: an interactive web simulator built with coding agents, used by a consórcio sales team to replace confusing spreadsheets.
mapa.context: A consórcio sales team used complex spreadsheets during client calls. Prospective buyers struggled to follow the raw numbers, and testing different terms or down payments required manual recalculation on the fly.
items: Live inputs for monthly income, property goal, down payment, and target timeframe.
Compares expected property inflation (7% per year) against investment yields (6.2% per year) over 30 years.
Simulates four bidding routes: regular raffle, fixed bid (44 installments), limited bid (88 installments), and free bid.
Side-by-side comparison of direct savings, bank mortgages, and consórcio installments.
mapa.decisions: Built for quick explanations during sales calls: adjusting the target timeframe immediately updates the monthly target and scenario summary.
steps: Enters income, target property price, and starting capital
Shows how property price inflation outpaces standard bank savings
Calculates the monthly savings needed for a 3-year versus 5-year target
Compares cash bids against embedded bids using up to 50% of the credit line
Presents a clear comparison against standard mortgage interest and total term costs
mapa.credit: Built for daily use by a consórcio sales team.
mapa.reach: Hosted on Vercel as a client-side app, letting sales reps test numbers live during calls without server maintenance.
mapa.linkLabel: explore Mapa da Bella live application
mapa.also: All numbers reflect user-entered assumptions. The tool supports sales conversations and does not provide credit approval, guarantees, or regulated financial advice.

supporting.title: Connecting AI tools with clear controls
supporting.summary: Grok MCP Bridge: a personal local integration connecting ChatGPT Chat to Grok Build, with task tracking and separately reviewed changes.
points: Separates code generation from project changes, keeping each step in a distinct review queue.
Uses persistent task IDs to track multi-step work across terminal sessions.
Requires manual inspection of git diffs and test results before applying any edits.
